translation_notes: Two existence reads over two different graphs, both discarding the matched value entirely (`is not None` / `is None`, never the type itself): `g.value(contentclass, RDF.type) is not None` -> `bool(m{ {contentclass} rdf:type ?t })` against the designated current graph `g`; `self.e.value(contentclass, RDF.type) is None` -> `not bool(m{ {contentclass} rdf:type ?t }(self.e))`, the `(graph)` call suffix naming the OTHER source without a second @graph declaration.

`self.e` is a plain attribute holding an rdflib.Graph (confirmed at entity.py:73, `self.e = Graph()`, in the real class this region's method belongs to) -- not a re-affected name, so the @graph scoping caveat about capturing a VALUE at its line does not bite here; `self.e` itself is never reassigned within the region.

context_shim.py: minimal `Entity` stand-in providing `self.e` (a Graph a test can pre-populate) and `add_enum_class` recorded rather than executed -- the real method's own graph-building logic is not part of this region and never runs either way; only whether it is CALLED is the region's own observable effect.

demo() harness (identical both sides, see meta.json): builds a fresh Entity(e_data), runs the region, returns the count of add_enum_class calls -- the one bit of information the `and` of two bool(m{ }) reads decides. Four calls cover all three reachable truth combinations of the `and` (True/True -> called; True/False and False/True and False/False -> not called), including a case where contentclass is entirely absent from `g` (case 4), proving the first read is not silently satisfied by data that lives only in self.e.

Deliberately broke the translation (dropped the `and not bool(m{ }(self.e))` conjunct) to confirm rdfeval check catches it: FAIL call[1].result: values differ (0 vs 1) -- case 2, typed in both graphs, should NOT call add_enum_class but did once the self.e check was removed. Restored, check is green again.

repair.driver: Trois appels de voisinage : contentclass typé dans g et, dans self.e, seulement sujet de rdfs:label (appelé) ; seulement objet de rdf:type dans self.e (appelé) ; non typé dans g alors qu'un autre sujet l'est (non appelé). Entrées URIRef, comme l'appelant réel (owl2instances.py:601, terme issu d'un résultat SPARQL). `constructions` complétée de `interpolation {expr}` ({contentclass} était employé, non déclaré).
mutants_killed: lecture de self.e : sujet et objet échangés (call[1], call[5])

optimization_notes: optimized.py: `g.value(c, RDF.type) is not None` becomes `(c, RDF.type, None) in g`, and `self.e.value(c, RDF.type) is None` becomes `... not in self.e`.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `m{ {contentclass} a ?t }(g) and not m{ {contentclass} a ?t }(self.e)`: the translation's `bool(...)` goes (a Solutions is truthy), and the call suffix replaces `@graph g`.
No other exception to the symmetry rule: outside the RDF lines the two files are identical line for line.
